VERSION.value: github.com/br3ttb/Arduino-PID-Library master as of 2026-09-12 (commit in hashes)

value.lineage: Beauregard PID (2011-): a widely-copied, carefully-engineered PID controller -- proportional/integral/derivative feedback with anti-windup, derivative-on-measurement, and bumpless mode switching; the reference small feedback controller of the maker world

HUMAN_PROBLEM.value: closed-loop regulation of a physical process

value.built_to: drive a measured process variable to a setpoint by feeding back the error through proportional, integral and derivative terms, robustly, on a tiny microcontroller
value.pressure: actuator limits (windup), noisy measurements (derivative kick), and mode changes (bumpless transfer) in a real physical loop with lag
value.success_means: the process variable reaches and holds the setpoint with acceptable overshoot/settling despite disturbances and saturation

value.pressure: actuator lag and saturation, measurement noise, load disturbance, setpoint changes
value.failure_condition: oscillation or runaway: bad gains make the loop unstable; integral windup overshoots; the controlled machine overheats/crashes/breaks
